items.title: Payment for 'Grundstückseintragung' offer
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment: 01.12.2026. No period calculation is needed; the date is stated explicitly. 2026-12-01 is a Tuesday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no shift applies.

warnings: This is not a bill for a service already owed or an official land-registry (Grundbuch) matter: the small print states 'Dieses Schreiben ist ein Angebot. Mit Ihrer Zahlung nehmen Sie es an; ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande' — i.e. it is an unsolicited commercial offer disguised as an invoice, and paying it would create a paid contract with this private company for an entry in its own private directory, which has no connection to the official German land register (Grundbuch) despite the official-sounding name, crest-like logo and invoice-style layout.

This matches a well-known German scam/sharp-practice pattern (similar to 'Gewerbeauskunft-Zentrale' and fake 'Grundbuch'/'Grundstücksregister' mailings) that relies on recipients mistaking it for an official or already-owed invoice; recommend not paying and, if in doubt, verifying with the real Grundbuchamt/Katasteramt and reporting the letter.
The IBAN given (DE59 5007 0010 0005 5707 00) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but a valid IBAN only confirms the format, not who actually controls the account or that any debt is genuine.

No legal remedy instructions (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) are given because this is a private commercial offer, not an administrative or court decision — there is no legal deadline to react to, only the sender's own payment request.
